items.title: Settle the fragmentation deficit and the information save shape
acceptance: a Decision logged block in docs/roadmap.md or a daily log names how a crossing's pre-crossing connectivity deficit is measured and how it maps onto the 1.0 to 2.0 fragmentation multiplier

the same block says whether the new optional crossings[].fragmentation_deficit field bumps save_version, with the reason (data-schemas §14 says a bump is MAJOR; ADR 0014 says absent optional keys take defaults)
the same block names how a purchased information product is recorded under the information save key, since areas_revealed[] cannot say which of three products an area holds
items.context: Two spec gaps found while routing Phase 3. The PRD says the multiplier comes 'from the pre-crossing connectivity deficit of the link' and defines no deficit; the code has no such measure. A proposal to accept or change: deficit = the share of the largest pre-crossing network that the link newly joins to it, (combined tile count of the distinct networks the crossing joins minus the largest network's tile count) divided by the largest network's tile count, capped at 1, so a link between two equal halves scores 1.0, one that joins a sliver to a large network scores near 0, and one between patches already in the same network scores 0; multiplier = FRAGMENTATION_MULT_MIN + deficit x (FRAGMENTATION_MULT_MAX - FRAGMENTATION_MULT_MIN). The first draft of this proposal used one minus the largest network's share of the combined total, which tops out at 0.5 for two networks and so never reaches the 2.0 end of the range. On the save: an optional float with a default of 0.0 loads under save_version 1 by ADR 0014's omit-means-default rule, so no bump. On information: keep areas_revealed[] and add a products map keyed by area id, or encode product and area together. Unblocks C14, C15 and C17. The dispatch cannot see a decision as done, so those items stay blocked until the next weekly plan marks Q4 done. Decided 2026-10-15 (Brent), recorded in docs/roadmap.md §Phase 3, second Decision logged block (PR #59, merge bed1768).

items.title: Store the fragmentation deficit on each crossing and in the save
acceptance: a completed crossing records fragmentation_deficit = min(1, (combined - largest) / largest), where combined is the total tile count (sum of patch_tile_count) of the distinct connectivity networks of the patches bordering its covered tiles and largest is the biggest of them, measured before its safe links are added; stored as an optional float on crossings[] (docs/roadmap.md Phase 3, second Decision logged block)

the field is written by save_state and read back by restore_state as stored; a restored crossing keeps its saved value rather than recomputing it, because restore replays crossings against a partly built graph
a save with no fragmentation_deficit key loads with 0.0 (a 1.0x multiplier) and does not fail
docs/data-schemas.md §14 documents the field; save_version is NOT bumped (the roadmap block decided additive and optional under ADR 0014); a test loads a save written before this change
the stated suite figure in docs/testing-setup.md is updated with tools/suite_figures.py --print and python3 tools/suite_figures.py --check docs/testing-setup.md passes
items.context: Supervised because it changes the save format. Q4 is decided: the formula, the stored field and the no-bump call are in the roadmap's second 2026-10-15 Decision logged block. Include tests for two equal halves (1.0), a 10 percent sliver (0.1) and patches already in one network (0). Merged: PR #64.

items.title: Pay monthly donations and the fundraising trickle
acceptance: at each month boundary Simulation calls the economy's monthly income, which pays BASE_GRANT plus, per crossing, this month's crossings times the mean species status_weight times a multiplier of FRAGMENTATION_MULT_MIN + stored fragmentation_deficit x (FRAGMENTATION_MULT_MAX - FRAGMENTATION_MULT_MIN), plus a milestone term (test_donation_formula)
the milestone term is a named function that returns 0, with a comment pointing at Phase 6
endangered crossings pay more than common ones for equal usage (test_status_weight_scaling) and the multiplier stays within FRAGMENTATION_MULT_MIN and MAX (test_fragmentation_multiplier_range)
when the budget is below the cost of the cheapest action, FUNDRAISING_TRICKLE is added (test_fundraising_trickle_prevents_deadlock)
donation_received(amount, breakdown) is emitted through EventBus with the base, per-crossing and milestone parts; the per-crossing tally resets each month
the stated suite figure in docs/testing-setup.md is updated with tools/suite_figures.py --print and python3 tools/suite_figures.py --check docs/testing-setup.md passes
items.context: Phase 3 exit criteria: the donation formula matches the spec across status weights and fragmentation multipliers, and the trickle prevents deadlock. Tallies come from animal_crossed; species weights from species_stats.json status_weight. The deficit is stored on each crossing by C14 and the multiplier is computed from it at income time (roadmap second 2026-10-15 block). Merged: PR #65.

items.title: Confirm the seasonal presence, migration and terrain rules
acceptance: a Decision logged block or a daily log accepts or changes: which species are absent in which season, the migration seasons, the motivation multiplier, and the winter and spring terrain rules below; if accepted, one line says so
items.context: The data says only each species' seasonal_pattern (resident, seasonal_migration, elevational_migration, hibernates); it names no seasons. Proposals: hibernates (grizzly) is absent in winter; seasonal_migration (elk, pronghorn) is absent in winter; elevational_migration (caribou, bighorn) is never absent; resident (wolverine, wolf, lynx) is never absent. Migration seasons for both migration patterns are spring and fall, when goal-distance willingness is multiplied by 1.5. Seasons run spring, summer, fall, winter from year 1 spring. Winter clears is_hazardous on river tiles; spring widens river hazard zones by one tile; summer and fall use the base terrain. C37 to C39 build on these proposals and do not wait for this item. Decided 2026-10-16 (evening): elk and pronghorn are present all year with migration spikes in spring and fall; only the grizzly is absent (winter). Recorded in the docs/roadmap.md Phase 4 Decision logged block.

acceptance: an effective seasonal terrain layer, derived from the current season and never saved, makes river tiles not hazardous in winter and widens river hazard zones by one tile in spring; summer and fall use the base terrain (test_frozen_river_clears_hazard covers winter clearing and spring restoring plus widening)

items.context: Phase 4: frozen and flooded terrain. Architectural, so opus and supervised.
